text:
cecil: Noticed onboarding sample app causing duplicate downstream jobs when folks hammer the "re-run" button. Lots of 429s then quick client retries.

ana: Which SDK and flow? streaming vs sync?

cecil: Node web sample, v1.5.1, sync gen. Users click fast while request pending.

priya: Two quick mitigations: client-side optimistic suppress (short window) + idempotency header for non-streaming calls. Server can keep a small TTL cache.

david: Agreed. Also need to make Node SDK defaults safer: exp backoff + full jitter and an opt-in helper to attach idempotency. Example header we can name: X-RW-Idempotency.

cecil: We also saw some 429s missing Retry-After which makes client backoff less effective. Snippet from logs: 
```
POST /v1/generate 429 - x-req: r_b7c - body: {"error":"rate_limited"}
```
No Retry-After.

ops-bot: Created issue INF-778 to audit routing fast-fail path for missing Retry-After.

ana: For UX: add a 400ms UI throttle and store a tiny recent-request hash in sessionStorage so identical payloads are suppressed for a few minutes. That prevents accidental multi-submits on reload too.

priya: SDK design proposal: 
- default retry: maxRetries=4, baseMs=120, maxMs=2200, jitter=full
- helper: client.withIdempotency(key) -> sets X-RW-Idempotency on non-stream requests only
- docs: clear note that streaming must not set idempotency.

cecil: Can someone pick the node PR? I can do the sampleapp UI work.

david: I'll take the node SDK patch. I will include unit tests that assert header present for sync generate and absent for streaming. Will also add an integration test that simulates 40 concurrent identical requests and expects single webhook delivery.

priya: Server-side: we'll keep a short-lived idempotency cache (TTL 5m) keyed by X-RW-Idempotency, and a small bloom filter for quick rejection in the hot path to avoid DB churn.

staging-bot: Smoke test queued: replay-suppression-staging -> queued.

cecil: Timeline: node PR + sampleapp change to staging by Friday would be ideal. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
